en: Fixed the "background service did not respond" error suggesting the disabled `claude daemon restart`; it now suggests `claude daemon stop --any` and says it ends background sessions
zh: 修复了“background service did not respond”错误建议使用已禁用的 `claude daemon restart` 的问题；现在改为建议 `claude daemon stop --any`，并说明该命令会结束后台 session
